title: Maximum 69 Number
summary: Given a positive integer made solely of digits 6 and 9, return the largest possible number by altering at most one digit, changing 6 to 9 or 9 to 6.
statement: Given a positive integer made solely of digits 6 and 9, return the largest possible number by altering at most one digit, changing 6 to 9 or 9 to 6.
constraints: num is positive and contains only digits six and nine.
Change at most one digit and maximize the resulting value.
hints: Changing a more significant digit dominates every less significant change.
Replace that digit with nine; if no six exists, return the original number.
This adds three times the largest available place value, which is the maximum possible gain.
editorial: This adds three times the largest available place value, which is the maximum possible gain.

tests.explanation: Changing the first six to nine gives 9969.
No change can improve a number containing only nines.
